module piso_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input load,
    input [7:0] pin,
    output reg sout
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst == 1) begin
            sout <= 1;
        end else begin
            if (load) begin
                sout <= pin[7];
            end else begin
                sout <= prev;
            end
        end
    end

    reg [7:0] prev;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst == 1) begin
            prev <= 8'd0;
        end else begin
            if (load) begin
                prev <= 8'd0;
            end else begin
                prev[7:0] <= {prev[6:0], sout};
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

  input clk,
  input areset,
  input load,
  input ena,
  input [3:0] data,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  reg [3:0] q_tmp;

    if (!areset) begin
      q_tmp[0] <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
      q_tmp[0] <= load ? data[0] : q_tmp[1];
    end
  end

  // Second FF
  always @(posedge clk or negedge areset) begin
    if (!areset) begin
      q_tmp[1] <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
      q_tmp[1] <= load ? data[1] : q_tmp[2]; // Door to the next stage
    end
  end

  // Third FF
  always @(posedge clk or negedge areset) begin
    if (!areset) begin
      q_tmp[2] <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
      q_tmp[2] <= load ? data[2] : q_tmp[3]; // Door to the next stage
    end
  end

  // Fourth FF
  always @(posedge clk or negedge areset) begin
    if (!areset) begin
      q_tmp[3] <= 1'b0;
    end
    else begin
      q_tmp[3] <= load ? data[3] : q_tmp[0]; // Door back to the first stage
    end
  end

  // Output assignment
  assign q = q_tmp;
